text:
Maya Patel: quick heads up — final merge window for v1.8 opens in ~2h. Can someone eyeball these PRs? Need approvals + changelog confirmation.
- #8421 router: batching fixes — needs backport to 1.7 (label backport/1.7)
- #8460 console: changelog entries for metrics UI — confirm wording
- #8472 runtime: kernel selection tweak — needs QA signoff and maybe a small doc blurb
We also plan to tag release/v1.8-rc1 immediately after cut. If you take something, reply with what you can own.

Alex Chen: I can take #8421. Will open the backport PR tonight.
Command I'll run: `git checkout -b backport/1.7/8421 && git cherry-pick -x <commit>`

Priya Singh: I'll review #8460 in the next 30m. Quick ask: can we shorten the changelog line to one sentence? Current draft is a bit long.
Suggested: "Improve metrics UI: add token-level latency breakdown"

Sam Torres: LGTM on #8472 from a code perspective, CI is flaky on CUDA tests though — tagging @eng-sre if QA env is required.

Jonah Kim: @Maya my QA slot is free at 3pm PT, can run the runtime tests then. If CI keeps failing, we should consider a canary rollout instead of full cut.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release checklist triggered for v1.8-rc1 in 120 minutes. Please ensure all PRs marked `release-ready` and changelog approved.

Maya Patel: thanks all — Alex please add the backport label when you push. Priya once you confirm wording I'll squash the changelog commit. Sam/Jonah coordinate on the QA run; if CI still unstable, we fallback to canary as Jonah suggested. I'll do the tag after final approvals. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8488 (adds label backport/1.7)

Priya Singh: changelog line shortened and pushed to #8460, PTAL.

Sam Torres: QA run scheduled at 3pm PT, will report back in this thread.

Maya Patel: perfect — will watch for the approvals and tag at ~4:30pm PT if everything passes.
